1.title: Delivering Outstanding Intelligent Equipment to World-Class Enterprises
1.contentHtml:
TXAM announced that its two intelligent manufacturing bases in Shenzhen and Huizhou have been fully completed and put into operation, marking the company's official entry into a new stage of large-scale development.

Dual-Base Layout Established

With the successful topping-out of TXAM's 60,000㎡ intelligent manufacturing base in Huizhou, TXAM has formed a "dual-core" layout with the Shenzhen headquarters as the core and Huizhou as the capacity expansion hub. This layout will provide strong production and delivery support for the company to undertake billion-yuan orders from world-class enterprises.

The Huizhou base adopts an industry-leading intelligent production line design, equipped with complete assembly, testing, and packaging systems, achieving full-process self-control from parts processing to final delivery.

Digital Management Upgrade

While enhancing production capacity, TXAM continues to advance its digital transformation. By deploying advanced MES manufacturing execution systems and WMS warehouse management systems, TXAM has achieved real-time collection, monitoring, and analysis of production data, greatly improving production efficiency and product quality stability.

The company stated that it will continue to increase R&D investment, deepen its focus on non-standard automation, and contribute more to China's intelligent manufacturing.

2.title: High-Precision Robotic Assembly Line Successfully Deployed at a Leading Home Appliance Manufacturer
2.contentHtml:
TXAM has successfully completed the installation and commissioning of a high-precision robotic assembly line customized for a well-known home appliance manufacturer, and it has officially entered production operation.

Project Background

This home appliance manufacturer operates multiple modern production lines both domestically and internationally, with extremely stringent requirements for the precision and stability of automation equipment. Leveraging 19 years of industry experience and technical expertise, TXAM won the bid and undertook the design and delivery of this major project.

Technical Highlights

The entire line utilizes TXAM's independently developed UVW vision alignment platform, combined with six-axis industrial robots, achieving assembly precision at the ±0.1mm level. With the CAD-import one-click changeover function, the entire line can complete product switching within 15 minutes, greatly enhancing production flexibility.

After project delivery, the customer's single-line production cycle time was reduced to 12 seconds per unit, with a yield rate exceeding 99.9%, earning high recognition from the customer.

3.title: TXAM Makes a Stunning Debut at CIBF International Battery Exhibition, "Cyclic Automatic Elevator" Attracts Much Attention
3.contentHtml:
In May 2025, TXAM showcased its independently developed core equipment such as the "Cyclic Automatic Elevator" at the CIBF International Battery Technology Exhibition, fully entering the new energy and intelligent warehousing and logistics sectors.

New Energy Sector Layout

Under the guidance of the "dual carbon" goals, the new energy industry is booming, and the demand for automation equipment is growing rapidly. TXAM has seized this opportunity by establishing a new energy intelligent equipment R&D team, focusing on the development and manufacturing of equipment for lithium battery module PACK production lines, intelligent warehousing and logistics systems, and other fields.

Core Product Showcase

The "Cyclic Automatic Elevator" exhibited this time adopts an advanced servo drive system and precision guide rail structure, featuring smooth operation, precise positioning, and high efficiency. It can be widely applied in new energy battery warehousing and logistics scenarios.

During the exhibition, the TXAM booth attracted numerous domestic and international customers for visits and negotiations, and multiple cooperation intentions were reached on site.

4.title: Milestone: TXAM's 100,000 sqm Dual Manufacturing Bases in Shenzhen & Huizhou Fully Completed
4.contentHtml:
In March 2026, TXAM's Huizhou Intelligent Manufacturing Base officially commenced full production, marking the formal establishment of the company's "Shenzhen-Huizhou dual-base, 100,000 sqm intelligent manufacturing" strategic layout.

Dual-Core Drive, Production Capacity Leap

The Huizhou base covers 60,000 sqm, featuring industry-leading intelligent production line designs and complete assembly, testing, and packaging systems. After full operation, the company's overall production capacity will more than double, with annual output value expected to reach hundreds of millions of yuan.

Serving World-Class Customers Globally

Leveraging expanded capacity and 19 years of technical expertise, TXAM is now capable of undertaking orders worth hundreds of millions of yuan from world-class enterprises. The company will continue to deepen its focus on non-standard automation, delivering higher-quality products and services to long-term partners such as TCL, Skyworth, Midea, Konka, and Changhong.

Looking ahead, TXAM will continue to advance intelligent manufacturing upgrades and contribute more to China's intelligent manufacturing sector.

5.title: Successfully Delivered 86" Commercial Display Fully Automated Assembly Line to Mexico
5.contentHtml:
In February 2026, TXAM successfully delivered a customized 86" commercial display fully automated assembly line to a renowned commercial display manufacturer in Mexico, with 5 containers of complete line equipment shipped cross-border.

Project Overview

The production line covers core processes such as automatic dispensing, high-precision lamination, and automatic screw fastening, perfectly solving the challenge of damage-free assembly for ultra-large flexible screens. This marks another major breakthrough for TXAM in the Americas market, following its success in Southeast Asia.

Technical Highlights

The entire line utilizes TXAM's independently developed high-precision robotic dispensing system (±0.2mm), combined with a UVW vision alignment platform, to achieve high-precision lamination of large-size panels. Through the intelligent control system, the production line enables one-click product switching, compatible with 65~110" multi-size products.

After overseas delivery, the equipment has operated stably and received high praise from the customer, laying a solid foundation for future in-depth cooperation.

6.title: Insight: The "Second Half" of New Energy Power Battery Assembly Technology
6.contentHtml:
With the explosive growth of the new energy vehicle market, power battery assembly technology is ushering in new development opportunities. This article explores the "second half" trends in new energy power battery assembly technology.

Automation Becomes a Necessity

Under the guidance of the "dual carbon" goals, the new energy industry is thriving, and the demand for power batteries is surging. Traditional manual assembly methods can no longer meet the needs for large-scale, high-efficiency, and high-quality production, making automated assembly technology an industry necessity.

Deep Integration of Software and Hardware

The core of a lights-out factory lies not in hardware stacking, but in the seamless flow of data. The efficient integration of the WCS warehouse control system with automated robotic arms is key to achieving intelligent production. Through the TCP/IP communication protocol, real-time interconnection of equipment status and digitalized transparent management of production data are realized.

TXAM, leveraging 19 years of deep expertise in the automation field, has successfully developed a series of equipment for new energy battery module PACK production lines, which have been deployed at multiple leading enterprises.
